DIAGNOSIS READY: Multiple System Atrophy (MSA).

The clinical picture of progressive parkinsonism (rigidity, tremor), autonomic failure (orthostatic hypotension, urinary incontinence), and bulbar symptoms (dysarthria) in a 54-year-old male is highly characteristic of this condition.
